labelAccountHint: Please provide the credentials of an ioBroker Google Account which you share your location with using the Google Maps App. It is strongly recommended to create a dedicated Google Account for this purpose.
Polling Interval (in seconds, at least 6: Polling Interval (in seconds, at least 60 seconds)
Fences, will create boolean states for e: Fences, will create boolean states for each fence to indicate if user is within the fence
labelChallengeHint: If Google asks for an additional confirmation during login (2FA, "Is this you?", "Choose the number shown"), the adapter keeps the invisible browser open for this long. The number you have to pick on your phone is published in the state info.loginPageText, a screenshot of the browser in info.loginScreenshot.
Wait for confirmation (in seconds, 0 dis: Wait for confirmation (in seconds, 0 disables waiting)
labelRemoteDebuggingHint: Only needed for troubleshooting: opens a Chrome DevTools debugging port for the login browser, so you can watch and control it. The port is bound to localhost only - reach it through an SSH tunnel, for example "ssh -L 9222:localhost:9222 user@iobroker-host", then open http://localhost:9222 in Chrome. Anyone who can reach this port can control the browser and read the Google session, so keep it switched off during normal operation.
Enable remote debugging of the login bro: Enable remote debugging of the login browser
